comments:
[4TBERVZD]: 72, n. 16 suggests that the "Rin chen tshul khrims" who composed work (ID:5271) could be the thirteenth abbot of the Bye rdzing pa monastic community and teacher of Dol po pa (ID:4213). A "Rin chen tshul khrims" (ID:7135) was a student of Dol po pa, see (ID:7135); his dates (1297-1368) were adopted for the author of (ID:5271) in [J4L5X9AG]: 431.
It is not certain whether the same "Rin chen tshul khrims" was the author of work (ID:5271) and of work (ID:6991).
alternative_names: gzhung rgya smra ba rin chen tshul khrims
